title: file.stats Response Application Programming Interface (API) Schema
description: Response containing resource statistics about local Notefiles.

changes.description: The number of Notes pending sync. Reflects only the Notefile named by the `file` argument, or all Notefiles when `file` is omitted.

sync.description: `true` if a sync is recommended. This is set when an in-scope Notefile's in-memory footprint reaches a critical size and should be flushed, not when a particular number of Notes is pending.

total.description: The total number of Notes, synced and unsynced. Reflects only the Notefile named by the `file` argument, or all Notefiles when `file` is omitted.

samples.title: File Statistics Response
samples.description: Response with resource statistics showing pending sync recommendation.

samples.title: No Pending Changes
samples.description: Response when no changes are pending sync.
